mechanism.claim: A completed daily BTC close that drives the canonical Wilder fourteen-day RSI to an overbought or oversold extreme during elevated realized variation represents one-sided displacement vulnerable to next-day mean reversion.
mechanism.side: long when RSI<=30; short when RSI>=70
mechanism.why_distinct: Existing RSI candidates require OI expansion or price/OI contradiction and use RSI only as a confirmation gate. HVWRSI is the fixed canonical two-sided RSI state itself, with no OI, flow, volume, funding, fitted threshold, prior event, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed twenty-day daily realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse daily canonical oscillator extremes are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every calendar day at exact 00:00 UTC
features.daily_close: last close of 1,440 exact coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-24h,D)
features.change: current completed daily close minus immediately prior completed daily close
features.wilder_seed: arithmetic mean gains and losses over the first fourteen exact changes from source start
features.rsi: 100-100/(1+avg_gain/avg_loss); avg_loss=0 maps 100, avg_gain=0 maps 0, both zero invalid
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared latest twenty completed daily close-to-close log returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligibility: RSI<=30 or RSI>=70 plus variation gate

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Wilder oscillator reversal under the user-requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no RSI period, recursive formula, 30/70 levels, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: J. Welles Wilder Jr., New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems (1978)
external_basis.fixed_definition: fourteen periods with Wilder recursive average gains and losses; conventional 30/70 extremes
external_basis.selection_use: canonical published formula and thresholds only; no candidate incidence or stage outcomes
